description: MAX98357A I2S class-D mono amplifier breakout

electrical.shutdown_pin: SD - tie low to mute, and gate the rail entirely if you care about sleep current

keepouts.reason: Screw-terminal speaker output on one edge.

traps: DO NOT power this from a small 3V3 LDO. It can pull about 1 A peak into a 4 ohm load. On the Heltec E290 the 3V3 rail is a CE6260B33M rated 600 mA, so feeding the amp from it overdraws the rail by a wide margin. Run it from VBAT with its own local bulk capacitance, and gate that rail with a load switch.
The peak-minus-average current here is ~1000 mA. Any load with a transient above about 100 mA needs declared bulk capacitance sited AT THE PART, not at the connector.
notes: Class-D amplifiers are efficient on average and brutal on transients. The average figure is what fools people; the peak is what browns out the MCU.
Bring it up ALONE. An I2S microphone and an I2S amplifier brought up together, producing silence, tells you nothing about which one is wrong.
